responsibility: Implements higher-level x86 backend feature support that is not basic instruction selection, especially out-of-line prologue/epilogue stub layout, scalar-to-vector transformation utilities, and function multiversioning dispatch machinery. It owns the xlogue_layout data and stub naming logic for MS-to-SysV save/restore stubs, the scalar-chain conversion framework used by x86 RTL optimization passes, and the generation of ifunc-based dispatchers and resolvers for target_clones/function multiversioning.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-features.h, which declares feature-support classes and interfaces, this file implements the higher-level x86 feature machinery itself, including xlogue stub layout logic, scalar-chain conversion support, and function multiversioning dispatcher/resolver generation.
